name: Tools | Options | Spelling
description: Windows MDM settings in the Tools | Options | Spelling category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Allow accented uppercase in French (User)
properties.description: Checks/Unchecks the option "Enforce accented uppercase in French".

properties.name: Arabic modes (User)
properties.description: Specifies the spelling rules to use for checking spelling of Arabic text. This option is available only if you are using a right-to-left language version of Microsoft Office or have installed Microsoft Office 2016 proofing tools or the Microsoft Office Single Language Pack 2016 for the language, and have enabled support for the language through Microsoft Office 2016 Language Preferences.

properties.name: Combine aux verb/adj. (User)
properties.description: Checks/Unchecks the corresponding UI option. This option is available only if you are using the Korean language version of Microsoft Office or have installed Microsoft Office 2016 proofing tools or the Microsoft Office Single Language Pack 2016 for Korean, and have enabled support for Korean through Microsoft Office 2016 Language Preferences.

properties.name: Flag Repeated Words (User)
properties.description: Allows users to flag or ignore repeated words.

properties.name: German: Use post-reform rules (User)
properties.description: Allows users to choose a particular spellchecking style; Pre-reform or post reform.

properties.name: Hebrew mode (User)
properties.description: Specifies the script to use for checking spelling of Hebrew text. This option is available only if you are using a right-to-left language version of Microsoft Office or have installed Microsoft Office 2016 proofing tools or the Microsoft Office Single Language Pack 2016 for that language, and have enabled support for the language through Microsoft Office 2016 Language Preferences.

properties.name: Ignore Internet and file addresses (User)
properties.description: Allow users to ignore URLs and file paths.

properties.name: Ignore words in UPPERCASE (User)
properties.description: Allow users to ignore words written in UPPERCASE.

properties.name: Ignore words with numbers (User)
properties.description: Allows users to ignore words with numbers.

properties.name: Process compound nouns (User)
properties.description: Checks/Unchecks the corresponding UI option. This option is available only if you are using the Korean language version of Microsoft Office or have installed Microsoft Office 2016 proofing tools or the Microsoft Office Single Language Pack 2016 for Korean, and have enabled support for Korean through Microsoft Office 2016 Language Preferences.

properties.name: Suggest from main dictionary only (User)
properties.description: Allows users to select words from main lexicon only.

properties.name: Use auto-change list (User)
properties.description: Checks/Unchecks the option "Search misused word list". This option is available only if you are using the Korean language version of Microsoft Office or have installed Microsoft Office 2016 proofing tools or the Microsoft Office Single Language Pack 2016 for Korean, and have enabled support for Korean through Microsoft Office 2016 Language Preferences.
